## Symmetric Cryptography
## 对称加密
You've learned the basic concepts underlying symmetric key cryptography, asymmetric key cryptography, and hashing functions. In this section, we'll take an in-depth look at several common symmetric cryptosystems.
您已经学习了对称密钥密码学、非对称密钥密码学和哈希函数的基本概念。在本节中，我们将深入探讨几种常见的对称密码系统。
### Block Cipher Modes of Operation
### 分组密码的工作模式
The symmetric key cryptography block cipher modes of operation describe the different ways that cryptographic algorithms may transform data to achieve sufficient complexity that offers protection against attack. The major modes of operation are: Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode Cipher Feedback (CFB) mode Output Feedback (OFB) mode Counter (CTR) mode Galois/Counter mode (GCM) Counter with Cipher Block Chaining Message Authentication Code (CCM) mode
对称密钥密码的分组密码工作模式描述了密码算法转换数据的不同方式，以达到足够的复杂度来抵御攻击。主要的工作模式包括：电子密码本（ECB）模式、密码分组链接（CBC）模式、密码反馈（CFB）模式、输出反馈（OFB）模式、计数器（CTR）模式、伽罗瓦/计数器（GCM）模式，以及计数器与密码分组链接消息认证码（CCM）模式。
### Electronic Codebook Mode
### 电子密码本模式
Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode is the simplest mode to understand and the least secure. Each time the algorithm processes a fixed block of data, it simply encrypts the block using the chosen secret key. This means that if the algorithm encounters the same block multiple times, it will produce the same encrypted block. If an enemy were eavesdropping on the communications, they could simply build a “codebook” of all the possible encrypted values. After a sufficient number of blocks were gathered, cryptanalytic techniques could be used to decipher some of the blocks and break the encryption scheme.
电子密码本（ECB）模式是最易于理解、同时也是安全性最低的模式。每当算法处理一个固定大小的数据块时，它仅使用选定的密钥对该数据块进行加密。这意味着，如果算法多次遇到相同的数据块，它将产生相同的加密数据块。若攻击者正在窃听通信，他们只需构建一个包含所有可能加密值的“密码本”。在收集到足够数量的数据块后，便可利用密码分析技术破解部分数据块，从而攻破整个加密方案。
This vulnerability makes it impractical to use ECB mode on any but the shortest transmissions. In everyday use, ECB is used only for exchanging small amounts of data, such as keys and parameters used to initiate other cryptographic modes as well as the cells in a database.
这一漏洞使得ECB模式除了用于最短的传输之外，在其他场景下均不切实际。在日常使用中，ECB仅用于交换少量数据，例如用于启动其他加密模式的密钥和参数，以及数据库中的单元。
### Cipher Block Chaining Mode
### 密码块链接模式
In Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode, each block of unencrypted text is XORed with the block of ciphertext immediately preceding it before it is encrypted. The decryption process simply decrypts the ciphertext and reverses the XOR operation. CBC implements an initialization vector (IV) and XORs it with the first block of the message, producing a unique output every time the operation is performed. The IV must be sent to the recipient, perhaps by tacking the IV onto the front of the completed ciphertext in plain form or by protecting it with ECB mode encryption using the same key used for the message. One important consideration when using CBC mode is that errors propagate—if one block is corrupted during transmission, it becomes impossible to decrypt that block and the next block as well.
在密码块链接（CBC）模式中，每个未加密的明文块在加密之前，会与紧邻的前一个密文块进行异或（XOR）运算。解密过程则只需解密密文并逆转异或操作。CBC 模式使用一个初始化向量（IV），并将其与消息的第一个块进行异或，从而每次执行操作时都产生唯一的输出。该 IV 必须发送给接收方，方式可以是将其以明文形式附加在完整密文的前面，或者使用与消息相同的密钥通过 ECB 模式加密来保护它。使用 CBC 模式时的一个重要注意事项是错误传播——如果传输过程中某个块被损坏，则不仅该块无法解密，其后的下一个块也将无法解密。
### Cipher Feedback Mode
### 密码反馈模式（Cipher Feedback Mode）
Cipher Feedback (CFB) mode is the streaming cipher version of CBC. In other words, CFB operates against data produced in real time. However, instead of breaking a message into blocks, it uses memory buffers of the same block size. As the buffer becomes full, it is encrypted and then sent to the recipients. Then the system waits for the next buffer to be filled as the new data is generated before it is in turn encrypted and then transmitted. Other than the change from preexisting data to real-time data, CFB operates in the same fashion as CBC. It uses an IV, and it uses chaining.
密码反馈（CFB）模式是密码分组链接（CBC）模式的流密码版本。换言之，CFB 对实时生成的数据进行操作。然而，它并非将消息分割成数据块，而是使用与块大小相同的内存缓冲区。当缓冲区填满时，即被加密并发送给接收方。随后，系统等待新数据生成以填充下一个缓冲区，再依次加密并传输。除了从预先存在的数据变为实时数据这一变化外，CFB 的运行方式与 CBC 相同：它使用初始向量（IV），并采用链接（chaining）机制。
### Output Feedback Mode
### 输出反馈（OFB）模式
In Output Feedback (OFB) mode, ciphers operate in almost the same fashion as they do in CFB mode. However, instead of XORing an encrypted version of the previous block of ciphertext, OFB XORs the plaintext with a seed value. For the first encrypted block, an IV is used to create the seed value. Future seed values are derived by running the algorithm on the previous seed value. The major advantages of OFB mode are that there is no chaining function and transmission errors do not propagate to affect the decryption of future blocks.
在输出反馈（OFB）模式下，密码算法的运行方式与 CFB 模式几乎相同。然而，OFB 并非将前一个密文块的加密版本与明文进行异或（XOR），而是将明文与一个种子值（seed value）进行异或。对于第一个加密块，使用初始向量（IV）来生成种子值；后续的种子值则通过对前一个种子值运行算法来获得。OFB 模式的主要优势在于：不存在链接函数（chaining function），且传输错误不会传播而影响后续块的解密。
### Counter Mode
### 计数器模式
Counter (CTR) mode uses a stream cipher similar to that used in CFB and OFB modes. However, instead of creating the seed value for each encryption/decryption operation from the results of the previous seed values, it uses a simple counter that increments for each operation. As with OFB mode, errors do not propagate in CTR mode.
计数器（CTR）模式使用一种与 CFB 和 OFB 模式类似的流密码。然而，它并非根据前一次种子值的结果来生成每次加密/解密操作的种子值，而是使用一个简单的计数器，该计数器在每次操作时递增。与 OFB 模式一样，CTR 模式中的错误不会传播。
CTR mode allows you to break an encryption or decryption operation into multiple independent steps. This makes CTR mode well suited for use in parallel computing.
CTR 模式允许将加密或解密操作分解为多个独立的步骤。这使得 CTR 模式非常适合用于并行计算。
### Galois/Counter Mode
### 伽罗瓦/计数器模式
Galois/Counter mode (GCM) takes the standard CTR mode of encryption and adds data authenticity controls to the mix, providing the recipient assurances of the integrity of the data received. This is done by adding authentication tags to the encryption process.
伽罗瓦/计数器模式（GCM）在标准计数器（CTR）加密模式的基础上增加了数据真实性控制功能，为接收方提供所接收数据的完整性保障。这是通过在加密过程中添加认证标签（authentication tags）来实现的。
### Counter with Cipher Block Chaining Message Authentication
### 计数器与密码块链消息认证
### Code Mode
### 代码模式
Similar to GCM, Counter with Cipher Block Chaining Message Authentication Code mode (CCM) combines a confidentiality mode with a data authenticity process. In this case, CCM ciphers combine the Counter (CTR) mode for confidentiality with the Cipher Block Chaining Message Authentication Code (CBC-MAC) algorithm for data authenticity.
与 GCM 类似，基于计数器的密码块链消息认证码模式（CCM）将机密性模式与数据真实性流程相结合。在此模式下，CCM 密码算法将用于机密性的计数器（CTR）模式与用于数据真实性的密码块链消息认证码（CBC-MAC）算法相结合。
Currently, CCM is used only with block ciphers that have a 128-bit block length (such as the AES algorithm) and require the use of a nonce that must be changed for each transmission.
目前，CCM 仅用于具有 128 位分组长度（如 AES 算法）的分组密码，并且要求使用每次传输都必须更改的临时值（nonce）。
GCM and CCM modes both include data authenticity in addition to confidentiality. They are, therefore, known as authenticated modes of encryption. ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, and CTR modes only provide confidentiality and are, therefore, known as unauthenticated modes.
GCM 和 CCM 模式除了提供机密性（confidentiality）之外，还包含数据真实性（data authenticity）。因此，它们被称为认证加密模式（authenticated modes of encryption）。而 ECB、CBC、CFB、OFB 和 CTR 模式仅提供机密性，因此被称为非认证模式（unauthenticated modes）。
### Data Encryption Standard
### 数据加密标准
The U.S. government published the Data Encryption Standard (DES) in 1977 as a proposed standard cryptosystem for all government communications. Because of flaws in the algorithm, cryptographers and the federal government no longer consider DES secure. It is widely believed that intelligence agencies routinely decrypt DESencrypted information. DES was superseded by the Advanced Encryption Standard in December 2001. It is still important to understand DES because it is the building block of Triple DES (3DES), a stronger encryption algorithm discussed in the next section.
美国政府于1977年发布了数据加密标准（DES），作为所有政府通信的拟议标准密码系统。由于算法存在缺陷，密码学家和联邦政府已不再认为DES是安全的。普遍认为，情报机构能够常规性地解密经DES加密的信息。DES于2001年12月被高级加密标准（AES）取代。然而，理解DES仍然很重要，因为它是三重DES（3DES）的基础构件，后者是一种更强的加密算法，将在下一节中讨论。
DES is a 64-bit block cipher that has five modes of operation: Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode, Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode, Cipher Feedback (CFB) mode, Output Feedback (OFB) mode, and Counter (CTR) mode. All of the DES modes operate on 64 bits of plaintext at a time to generate 64-bit blocks of ciphertext. The key used by DES is 56 bits long.
DES是一种64位分组密码（block cipher），具有五种工作模式：电子密码本（ECB）模式、密码分组链接（CBC）模式、密码反馈（CFB）模式、输出反馈（OFB）模式和计数器（CTR）模式。所有DES模式每次对64位明文进行操作，生成64位密文块。DES使用的密钥长度为56位。
DES uses a long series of exclusive OR (XOR) operations to generate the ciphertext. This process is repeated 16 times for each encryption/decryption operation. Each repetition is commonly referred to as a round of encryption, explaining the statement that DES performs 16 rounds of encryption. Each round generates a new key that is then used as the input to subsequent rounds.
DES 使用一系列长串的异或（XOR）操作来生成密文。该过程在每次加密/解密操作中重复 16 次。每次重复通常被称为一轮加密，这解释了“DES 执行 16 轮加密”的说法。每一轮都会生成一个新密钥，该密钥随后作为后续轮的输入。
As mentioned, DES uses a 56-bit key to drive the encryption and decryption process. However, you may read in some literature that DES uses a 64-bit key. This is not an inconsistency—there's a perfectly logical explanation. The DES specification calls for a 64-bit key. However, of those 64 bits, only 56 actually contain keying information. The remaining 8 bits are supposed to contain parity information to ensure that the other 56 bits are accurate. In practice, however, those parity bits are rarely used. You should commit the 56-bit figure to memory.
如前所述，DES 使用 56 位密钥来驱动加密和解密过程。然而，您可能会在某些文献中读到 DES 使用 64 位密钥。这并非矛盾——有一个完全合理的解释。DES 规范要求使用 64 位密钥，但在这 64 位中，实际上只有 56 位包含密钥信息。剩余的 8 位本应包含奇偶校验信息，用于确保其他 56 位的准确性。然而，在实践中，这些奇偶校验位很少被使用。您应牢记 56 位这个数字。
### Triple DES
### 三重DES
As mentioned in previous sections, the Data Encryption Standard's (DES) 56-bit key is no longer considered adequate in the face of modern cryptanalytic techniques and supercomputing power. However, an adapted version of DES, Triple DES (3DES), uses the same algorithm to produce encryption that is stronger but that is no longer considered adequate to meet modern requirements. For this reason, 3DES encryption should be avoided, although it may still be supported by some products.
如前文所述，数据加密标准（DES）的56位密钥在现代密码分析技术与超级计算能力面前已不再被视为足够安全。然而，DES的一种改编版本——三重DES（3DES）——采用了相同的算法来生成更强的加密，但该算法同样不再被认为能够满足现代安全需求。因此，应避免使用3DES加密，尽管某些产品可能仍对其提供支持。
As of January 1, 2024, the U.S. federal government formally disallowed the use of 3DES for government data. The algorithm is still used in private industry.
自2024年1月1日起，美国联邦政府正式禁止在政府数据中使用3DES（三重DES）算法。该算法在私营行业中仍在使用。
There are several different variants of 3DES that each use different numbers of independent keys. The first two, DES-EDE3 and DESEEE3, use three independent keys: K , K , and K . The difference 1 2 3 between the two are the operations used, which are represented by the letter E for encryption and D for decryption. DES-EDE3 encrypts the data with K1, decrypts the resulting ciphertext with K2, and then encrypts that text with K3. DES-EDE3 can be expressed using the following notation, where E(K,P) represents the encryption of plaintext P with key K, and D(K,C) represents the decryption of ciphertext C with key K: E(K1,D(K2,E(K3,P))) DES-EEE3, on the other hand, encrypts the data with all three keys in sequential order, and may be represented as follows: E(K1,E(K2,E(K3,P)))
3DES（三重DES）存在多种变体，每种变体使用不同数量的独立密钥。前两种变体为DES-EDE3和DES-EEE3，它们使用三个独立密钥：K1、K2和K3。两者的区别在于所执行的操作，其中字母E代表加密（Encryption），D代表解密（Decryption）。DES-EDE3先用K1加密数据，再用K2对所得密文进行解密，最后用K3对该文本进行加密。DES-EDE3可用以下符号表示，其中E(K,P)表示用密钥K对明文P进行加密，D(K,C)表示用密钥K对密文C进行解密：E(K1, D(K2, E(K3, P)))。而DES-EEE3则按顺序使用全部三个密钥对数据进行加密，可表示为：E(K1, E(K2, E(K3, P)))。
If you find yourself wondering why there is a decryption operation in the middle of EDE3 mode, that's an arcane artifact of the process used to create the algorithm and provide backward compatibility with DES. Encryption and decryption are reversible operations, so even though the decryption function is used, it can still be thought of as a round of encryption.
如果您疑惑为何EDE3模式中间会有一个解密操作，这其实是该算法创建过程中为了提供与DES的向后兼容性（backward compatibility）而留下的一个晦涩的产物（arcane artifact）。加密与解密是可逆操作，因此即便使用了解密函数，它仍可被视为一轮加密。
Mathematically, DES-EEE3 and DES-EDE3 should have an effective key length of 168 bits. However, known attacks against this algorithm reduce the effective strength to 112 bits.
从数学上讲，DES-EEE3和DES-EDE3应具有168位的有效密钥长度（effective key length）。然而，针对该算法的已知攻击将其有效强度（effective strength）降低至112位。
This discussion raises an obvious question—what happened to Double DES (2DES)? You'll read in Chapter 7 that Double DES was tried but quickly abandoned when it was proven that an attack known as the meet-in-the-middle attack rendered it no more secure than standard DES.
上述讨论引出一个显而易见的问题——双重DES（Double DES, 2DES）发生了什么？你将在第7章中了解到，双重DES曾被尝试使用，但很快就被放弃了，因为事实证明一种被称为中间相遇攻击（meet-in-the-middle attack）的攻击手段使其安全性并不比标准DES更高。
### International Data Encryption Algorithm
### 国际数据加密算法
The International Data Encryption Algorithm (IDEA) block cipher was developed in response to complaints about the insufficient key length of the DES algorithm. Like DES, IDEA operates on 64-bit blocks of plaintext/ciphertext. However, it begins its operation with a 128-bit key. This key is broken up in a series of operations into 52 16-bit subkeys. The subkeys then act on the input text using a combination of XOR and modulus operations to produce the encrypted/decrypted version of the input message. IDEA is capable of operating in the same five modes used by DES: ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, and CTR.
国际数据加密算法（IDEA）分组密码是针对DES算法密钥长度不足的批评而开发的。与DES类似，IDEA对64位明文/密文块进行操作，但其初始密钥长度为128位。该密钥通过一系列运算被分解为52个16位子密钥。随后，这些子密钥结合异或（XOR）与模运算对输入文本进行处理，从而生成输入消息的加密/解密版本。IDEA能够支持与DES相同的五种工作模式：ECB、CBC、CFB、OFB和CTR。
All of this material on key length block size and the number of rounds of encryption may seem dreadfully boring; however, it's important material, so be sure to brush up on it while preparing for the exam.
所有这些关于密钥长度、块大小和加密轮数的内容可能看起来极其枯燥；然而，这些都是重要知识点，因此在备考时务必加以复习。
The IDEA algorithm was patented by its Swiss developers. However, the patent expired in 2012, and it is now available for unrestricted use. One popular implementation of IDEA is found in Phil Zimmermann's popular Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) secure email package. Chapter 7 covers PGP in further detail.
IDEA 算法曾由其瑞士开发者持有专利。然而，该专利已于 2012 年到期，目前可不受限制地自由使用。IDEA 的一个常见实现见于 Phil Zimmermann 开发的广受欢迎的 Pretty Good Privacy（PGP） 安全电子邮件套件中。第 7 章将更详细地介绍 PGP。
### Blowfish
### 河豚（Blowfish）
Bruce Schneier's Blowfish block cipher is another alternative to DES and IDEA. Like its predecessors, Blowfish operates on 64-bit blocks of text. However, it extends IDEA's key strength even further by allowing the use of variable-length keys ranging from a relatively insecure 32 bits to an extremely strong 448 bits. Obviously, the longer keys will result in corresponding increases in encryption/decryption time. However, time trials have established Blowfish as a much faster algorithm than both IDEA and DES. Also, Schneier released Blowfish for public use with no license required. Blowfish encryption is built into a number of commercial software products and operating systems. A number of Blowfish libraries are also available for software developers, and it is often used for Secure Shell (SSH) connections.
Bruce Schneier 设计的河豚（Blowfish）分组密码是 DES 和 IDEA 的另一种替代方案。与其前身类似，Blowfish 对 64 位数据块进行操作。然而，它通过允许使用可变长度密钥（从相对不安全的 32 位到极其强大的 448 位）进一步扩展了 IDEA 的密钥强度。显然，较长的密钥会导致加密/解密时间相应增加。但时间测试表明，Blowfish 比 IDEA 和 DES 都快得多。此外，Schneier 将 Blowfish 公开发布，无需任何许可证即可使用。Blowfish 加密已内置于众多商业软件产品和操作系统中。软件开发人员也可获取多种 Blowfish 库，并且它常被用于安全外壳（SSH）连接。
### SKIPJACK
### 跳棋（SKIPJACK）
Developed by the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA), the algorithm code named SKIPJACK was approved for use by the U.S. government in Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 185, the Escrowed Encryption Standard (EES) in 1994. SKIPJACK uses an 80-bit key and operates on 64-bit blocks of text. SKIPJACK was quickly embraced by the U.S. government and provided the cryptographic routines supporting the Clipper and Capstone encryption chips.
由美国国家安全局（NSA）开发、代号为跳棋（SKIPJACK）的算法，于1994年经美国联邦信息处理标准（FIPS）185《托管加密标准（EES）》批准用于美国政府。跳棋使用80位密钥，对64位数据块进行运算。该算法迅速被美国政府采纳，并为支持Clipper和Capstone加密芯片提供了密码例程。
However, SKIPJACK had an added twist—it supports the escrow of encryption keys. At the time, two government agencies, the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and the U.S. Department of the Treasury, each held a portion of the information required to reconstruct a SKIPJACK key. When law enforcement authorities obtained legal authorization, they would contact the two agencies to obtain the pieces of the key, enabling them to decrypt communications between the affected parties.
然而，跳棋（SKIPJACK） 有一个额外的变数——它支持加密密钥托管（escrow of encryption keys）。当时，两个政府机构——美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST） 和美国财政部——各自持有重建跳棋密钥所需的部分信息。当执法机构获得合法授权后，它们会联系这两个机构以获取密钥片段，从而能够解密相关通信方的通信内容。
SKIPJACK and the Clipper chip were not embraced by the cryptographic community at large because of its mistrust of the escrow procedures in place within the U.S. government.
跳棋（SKIPJACK） 和 剪裁（Clipper）芯片 并未被密码学界广泛接受，原因是业界对美国政府的密钥托管程序缺乏信任。
### Rivest Ciphers
### Rivest 密码
Ron Rivest, of Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) Data Security, created a series of symmetric ciphers over the years known as the Rivest Ciphers (RC) family of algorithms. Several of these, RC4, RC5, and RC6, have particular importance today.
Ron Rivest（Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) 数据安全公司的创始人之一）多年来创建了一系列对称密码，统称为 Rivest 密码（RC） 算法家族。其中，RC4、RC5 和 RC6 在当今具有特别重要的意义。
### Rivest Cipher 4 (RC4)
### Rivest 密码 4（RC4）
RC4 is a stream cipher developed by Rivest in 1987 and very widely used during the decades that followed. It uses a single round of encryption and allows the use of variable-length keys ranging from 40 bits to 2,048 bits. RC4's adoption was widespread because it was integrated into the Wired Equivalent Privacy (WEP), Wi-Fi Protected Access (WPA), Secure Sockets Layer (SSL), and Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocols.
RC4 是由 Rivest 于 1987 年开发的一种流密码（Stream Cipher），在随后的几十年中被广泛使用。它采用单轮加密（Single Round of Encryption），并支持使用长度从 40 位到 2,048 位的可变长度密钥（Variable-Length Keys）。RC4 之所以被广泛采用，是因为它被集成到了有线等效保密（WEP）、Wi-Fi 保护访问（WPA）、安全套接层（SSL）以及传输层安全（TLS）协议中。
A series of attacks against this algorithm render it insecure for use today. WEP, WPA, and SSL no longer meet modern security standards for both this and other reasons. TLS no longer allows the use of RC4 as a stream cipher.
针对该算法的一系列攻击已使其在当前环境下不再安全。出于这一原因及其他因素，WEP、WPA 和 SSL 已不再符合现代安全标准。TLS 协议也已禁止使用 RC4 作为流密码（Stream Cipher）。
### Rivest Cipher 5 (RC5)
### Rivest密码5（RC5）
RC5 is a block cipher of variable block sizes (32, 64, or 128 bits) that uses key sizes between 0 (zero) length and 2,040 bits. It is important to note that RC5 is not simply the next version of RC4. In fact, it is completely unrelated to the RC4 cipher. Instead, RC5 is an improvement on an older algorithm called RC2 that is no longer considered secure.
RC5 是一种分组密码（block cipher），支持可变的分组大小（32、64 或 128 位），密钥长度范围从 0（零）到 2,040 位。需要特别注意的是，RC5 并非 RC4 的简单升级版本；事实上，它与 RC4 密码完全无关。相反，RC5 是对一种更早的算法——RC2 的改进，而 RC2 已不再被认为是安全的。
RC5 is the subject of brute-force cracking attempts. A large-scale effort leveraging massive community computing resources cracked a message encrypted using RC5 with a 64-bit key, but this effort took more than four years to crack a single message.
RC5 是暴力破解（brute-force cracking）尝试的目标。一项利用大规模社区计算资源（massive community computing resources）的浩大工程成功破解了一条使用 64 位密钥的 RC5 加密消息，但这一努力花费了四年多的时间才破解了单条消息。
### Rivest Cipher 6 (RC6)
### 里维斯特密码 6（RC6）
RC6 is a block cipher that was developed as the next version of RC5. It uses a 128-bit block size and allows the use of 128-, 192-, or 256-bit symmetric keys. This algorithm was one of the candidates for selection as the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) discussed in the next section, but it was not selected and is not widely used today.
RC6 是一种分组密码，作为 RC5 的下一代版本而开发。它采用 128 位分组长度，并支持使用 128 位、192 位或 256 位的对称密钥。该算法曾作为高级加密标准（AES）的候选算法之一参与竞争（AES 将在下一节讨论），但最终未被选中，且目前并未得到广泛使用。
### Advanced Encryption Standard
### 高级加密标准
In October 2000, NIST announced that the Rijndael (pronounced “rhine-doll”) block cipher had been chosen as the replacement for DES. In November 2001, NIST released FIPS 197, which mandated the use of AES/Rijndael for the encryption of all sensitive but unclassified data by the U.S. government.
2000年10月，美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）宣布Rijndael（发音为“rhine-doll”）分组密码被选为DES的替代算法。2001年11月，NIST发布了FIPS 197标准，该标准强制要求美国政府使用AES/Rijndael对所有敏感但非机密的数据进行加密。
The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) cipher allows the use of three key strengths: 128 bits, 192 bits, and 256 bits. AES only allows the processing of 128-bit blocks, but Rijndael exceeded this specification, allowing cryptographers to use a block size equal to the key length. The number of encryption rounds depends on the key length chosen: 128-bit keys require 10 rounds of encryption. 192-bit keys require 12 rounds of encryption. 256-bit keys require 14 rounds of encryption.
高级加密标准（AES）密码支持三种密钥强度：128位、192位和256位。AES仅允许处理128位的数据块，但Rijndael超出了这一规范，允许密码学家使用与密钥长度相等的块大小。加密轮数取决于所选的密钥长度：128位密钥需要10轮加密，192位密钥需要12轮加密，256位密钥需要14轮加密。
### CAST
### CAST（加密算法）
The CAST algorithms, named after their creators, Carlisle Adams and Stafford Tavares, are another family of symmetric key block ciphers that are integrated into some security solutions. The CAST algorithms use a Feistel network and come in two forms: CAST-128 uses either 12 or 16 rounds of Feistel network encryption with a key size between 40 and 128 bits on 64-bit blocks of plaintext. CAST-256 uses 48 rounds of encryption with a key size of 128, 160, 192, 224, or 256 bits on 128-bit blocks of plaintext.
CAST 算法以其创建者 Carlisle Adams 和 Stafford Tavares 的名字命名，是另一类集成于某些安全解决方案中的对称密钥分组密码（symmetric key block cipher）。CAST 算法采用 Feistel 网络（Feistel network），并有两种形式：CAST-128 使用 12 或 16 轮 Feistel 网络加密，密钥长度介于 40 至 128 位之间，作用于 64 位的明文块；CAST-256 则使用 48 轮加密，密钥长度可为 128、160、192、224 或 256 位，作用于 128 位的明文块。
The CAST-256 algorithm was a candidate for the Advanced Encryption Standard but was not selected for that purpose.
CAST-256 算法曾作为高级加密标准（Advanced Encryption Standard，AES）的候选算法之一，但最终并未被选为该标准。
### Comparison of Symmetric Encryption Algorithms
### 对称加密算法比较
There are many symmetric encryption algorithms you need to be familiar with. Table 6.9 lists several common and well-known symmetric encryption algorithms along with their block size and key size.
有许多对称加密算法需要你熟悉。表6.9列出了几种常见且知名的对称加密算法，以及它们的块大小和密钥大小。

### Symmetric Key Management

Because cryptographic keys contain information essential to the security of the cryptosystem, it is incumbent upon cryptosystem users and administrators to take extraordinary measures to protect the security of the keying material. These security measures are collectively known as key management practices. They include safeguards surrounding the creation, distribution, storage, destruction, recovery, and escrow of symmetric (secret) keys.
### 对称密钥管理 由于密码密钥包含对密码系统安全至关重要的信息，密码系统的用户和管理员有责任采取特殊措施来保护密钥材料的安全性。这些安全措施统称为密钥管理实践。它们包括围绕对称（秘密）密钥的创建、分发、存储、销毁、恢复和托管（Escrow）所实施的安全防护措施。
### Creation and Distribution of Symmetric Keys

As previously mentioned, one of the major problems underlying symmetric encryption algorithms is the secure distribution of the secret keys required to operate the algorithms. The three main methods used to exchange secret keys securely are offline distribution, public key encryption, and the Diffie–Hellman key exchange algorithm.
### 对称密钥的创建与分发 如前所述，对称加密算法面临的主要难题之一，是安全地分发运行这些算法所需的秘密密钥。用于安全交换秘密密钥的三种主要方法分别是：离线分发（Offline Distribution）、公钥加密（Public Key Encryption）以及迪菲-赫尔曼密钥交换算法（Diffie–Hellman Key Exchange Algorithm）。
### Offline Distribution 
The most technically simple (but physically inconvenient) method involves the physical exchange of key material. One party provides the other party with a sheet of paper or piece of storage media containing the secret key. In many hardware encryption devices, this key material comes in the form of an electronic device that resembles an actual key that is inserted into the encryption device. However, every offline key distribution method has its own inherent flaws. If keying material is sent through the mail, it might be intercepted. Telephones can be wiretapped. Papers containing keys might be inadvertently thrown in the trash or lost.
### 离线分发 技术层面上最简单（但物理上不便）的方法涉及密钥材料的物理交换。一方将写有秘密密钥的纸张或存储介质交给另一方。在许多硬件加密设备中，这种密钥材料以类似于实际钥匙的电子设备形式提供，可插入加密设备。然而，每种离线密钥分发方法都有其固有的缺陷。如果密钥材料通过邮件发送，可能会被截获。电话可能被窃听。包含密钥的纸张可能被无意中丢弃或丢失。
The use of offline distribution is cumbersome for end users, particularly when they are located in geographically distant locations.
离线分发对于最终用户而言非常繁琐，尤其是当用户位于地理位置相距较远的地区时。
### Public Key Encryption 
Many communicators want to obtain the speed benefits of secret key encryption without the hassles of key distribution. For this reason, many people use public key encryption to set up an initial communications link. Once the link is successfully established and the parties are satisfied as to each other's identity, they exchange a secret key over the secure public key link. They then switch communications from the public key algorithm to the secret key algorithm and enjoy the increased processing speed. In general, secret key encryption is thousands of times faster than public key encryption.
### 公钥加密许多通信方希望获得秘密密钥加密的速度优势，同时又不想面对密钥分发的麻烦。因此，许多人使用公钥加密（Public Key Encryption）来建立初始通信链路。一旦链路成功建立且双方确认了彼此的身份，他们便通过安全的公钥链路交换一个秘密密钥。随后，通信从公钥算法切换至秘密密钥算法，从而享受更快的处理速度。通常，秘密密钥加密的速度比公钥加密快数千倍。
### Diffie–Hellman 
In some cases, neither public key encryption nor offline distribution is sufficient. Two parties might need to communicate with each other, but they have no physical means to exchange key material, and there is no public key infrastructure in place to facilitate the exchange of a secret key. In situations like this, key exchange algorithms like the Diffie–Hellman algorithm prove to be extremely useful mechanisms. You'll find a complete discussion of Diffie–Hellman in Chapter 7.
### 迪菲-赫尔曼（Diffie-Hellman） 在某些情况下，公钥加密或离线分发均不足以解决问题。通信双方可能需要彼此通信，但既没有物理手段交换密钥材料，也不存在现成的公钥基础设施来协助秘密密钥的交换。在这种场景下，像迪菲-赫尔曼算法（Diffie-Hellman algorithm）这样的密钥交换算法（Key Exchange Algorithms）便成为极为有用的机制。你将在第7章中找到关于迪菲-赫尔曼的完整讨论。
### Storage and Destruction of Symmetric Keys
### 对称密钥的存储与销毁
Another major challenge with the use of symmetric key cryptography is that all of the keys used in the cryptosystem must be kept secure. This includes following best practices surrounding the storage of encryption keys: Never store an encryption key on the same system where encrypted data resides. This just makes it easier for the attacker! For sensitive keys, consider providing two different individuals with half of the key. They then must collaborate to re-create the entire key. This is known as the principle of split knowledge (discussed earlier in this chapter).
使用对称密钥密码学面临的另一大挑战是，密码系统中使用的所有密钥都必须保持安全。这包括遵循围绕加密密钥存储的最佳实践：切勿将加密密钥存储在加密数据所在的同一系统上。这只会让攻击者更容易得手！对于敏感密钥，可考虑将密钥分成两半，分别交给两个不同的人。他们必须协作才能重新生成完整的密钥。这被称为分割知识（Split Knowledge） 原则（本章前面已讨论过）。
When a user with knowledge of a secret key leaves the organization or is no longer permitted access to material protected with that key, the keys must be changed, and all encrypted materials must be reencrypted with the new keys.
当掌握密钥的用户离开组织或不再被允许访问受该密钥保护的材料时，必须更换密钥，并使用新密钥对所有已加密的材料进行重新加密。
When choosing a key storage mechanism, you have three major options available to you: Software-based storage mechanisms store keys as digital objects on the system where they are used. For example, this might involve storing the key on the local file system. More advanced software-based mechanisms may use specialized applications to protect those keys, including the use of secondary encryption to prevent unauthorized access to the keys. Software-based approaches are generally simple to implement but introduce the risk of the software mechanism being compromised. Hardware-based storage mechanisms are dedicated hardware devices used to manage cryptographic keys. These may be personal devices, such as flash drives or smartcards that store a key used by an individual, or they may be enterprise devices, called hardware security modules (HSMs), that manage keys for an organization. Hardware approaches are more complex and expensive to implement than software approaches, but they offer added security. Cloud-based storage mechanisms take the HSM approach and implement it in the data centers of cloud service providers. Major cloud service providers, including AWS and Microsoft, offer HSM solutions for secure key management.
在选择密钥存储机制时，主要有三种方案可供选择：基于软件的存储机制将密钥作为数字对象存储在所使用的系统上。例如，这可能涉及将密钥存储在本地文件系统中。更高级的基于软件的机制可能使用专用应用程序来保护这些密钥，包括使用二次加密以防止对密钥的未授权访问。基于软件的方法通常易于实施，但存在软件机制被攻破的风险。 基于硬件的存储机制是用于管理加密密钥的专用硬件设备。这些设备可以是个人设备，例如存储个人所用密钥的闪存盘或智能卡；也可以是企业级设备，称为硬件安全模块（HSM），用于管理组织的密钥。与软件方法相比，硬件方法的实施更复杂且成本更高，但提供了更高的安全性。 基于云的存储机制采用HSM方案，并将其部署在云服务提供商的数据中心中。包括AWS和微软在内的主要云服务提供商都提供用于安全密钥管理的HSM解决方案。
### Key Escrow and Recovery
### 密钥托管与恢复
Cryptography is a powerful tool. Like most tools, it can be used for a number of beneficent purposes, but it can also be used with malicious intent. To gain a handle on the explosive growth of cryptographic technologies, governments around the world have floated ideas to implement key escrow systems. These systems allow the government, under limited circumstances such as a court order, to obtain the cryptographic key used for a particular communication from a central storage facility.
密码学是一种强大的工具。与大多数工具一样，它可用于多种有益目的，但也可能被用于恶意意图。为了应对密码技术的爆炸式增长，世界各国政府纷纷提出实施密钥托管系统（Key Escrow Systems）的构想。这些系统允许政府在有限的情况下（例如依据法院命令）从中央存储设施获取用于特定通信的密钥。
Two major approaches to key escrow have been proposed over the past decade:
过去十年间，业界提出了两种主要的密钥托管（Key Escrow）方法：
### Fair Cryptosystems 
In this escrow approach, the secret keys used in a communication are divided into two or more pieces, each of which is given to an independent third party. Each of these pieces is useless on its own, but they may be recombined to obtain the secret key. When the government obtains legal authority to access a particular key, it provides evidence of the court order to each of the third parties and then reassembles the secret key.
### 公平密码系统（Fair Cryptosystems） 在这种密钥托管方法中，通信所使用的密钥被分割成两个或多个片段，每个片段交由一个独立的第三方保管。这些片段各自单独使用时毫无价值，但可以重新组合以还原出完整的密钥。当政府获得合法授权以访问特定密钥时，需向每个第三方出示法院令状（Court Order）的证据，随后将密钥片段重新组装。
### Escrowed Encryption Standard 
This escrow approach provides the government or another authorized agent with a technological means to decrypt ciphertext. It was the approach proposed for the Clipper chip.
### 托管加密标准（Escrowed Encryption Standard） 这种密钥托管方法为政府或其他授权代理提供了一种技术手段来解密密文。该方案最初是为 Clipper 芯片（Clipper chip）所提出的。
It's highly unlikely that government regulators will ever overcome the legal and privacy hurdles necessary to implement key escrow on a widespread basis. The technology is certainly available, but the general public will likely never accept the potential government intrusiveness it facilitates.
政府监管机构极不可能克服实施大规模密钥托管（Key Escrow）所需的法律与隐私障碍。相关技术固然存在，但公众很可能永远不会接受其所助长的潜在政府侵入性（Government Intrusiveness）。
There are, however, legitimate uses for key escrow within an organization. Key escrow and recovery mechanisms prove useful when an individual leaves the organization and other employees require access to their encrypted data, or when a key is simply lost. In these approaches, key recovery agents (RAs) have the ability to recover the encryption keys assigned to individual users. This is, of course, an extremely powerful privilege, as an RA could gain access to any user's encryption key. For this reason, many organizations choose to adopt a mechanism known as M of N control for key recovery. In this approach, there is a group of individuals of size N in an organization who are granted RA privileges. If they wish to recover an encryption key, a subset of at least M of them must agree to do so. For example, in an M-of-N control system where M=3 and N=12, there are 12 authorized recovery agents, of whom 3 must collaborate to retrieve an encryption key.
然而，密钥托管（Key Escrow）在组织内部确实存在合法用途。当员工离职而其他员工需要访问其加密数据，或密钥意外丢失时，密钥托管与恢复机制（Key Escrow and Recovery Mechanisms）便显得尤为有用。在这些方案中，密钥恢复代理（Recovery Agents, RAs）能够恢复分配给各个用户的加密密钥。这显然是一项极其强大的权限，因为密钥恢复代理可以获取任何用户的加密密钥。因此，许多组织选择采用一种称为 M/N 控制（M of N Control）的机制来实现密钥恢复。在该机制中，组织内有一个由 N 名成员组成的群体被授予密钥恢复代理权限。若需恢复某个加密密钥，必须至少有其中 M 名成员同意才能执行。例如，在一个 M=3、N=12 的 M/N 控制系统中，共有 12 名授权恢复代理，其中必须至少有 3 人协作才能检索到加密密钥。
## Cryptographic Life Cycle
## 加密生命周期
With the exception of the one-time pad, all cryptographic systems have a limited life span. Moore's law, a commonly cited trend in the advancement of computing power, states that the processing capabilities of a state-of-the-art microprocessor will double approximately every two years. This means that, eventually, processors will reach the amount of strength required to simply guess the encryption keys used for a communication.
除了一次性密码本（one-time pad）之外，所有加密系统都具有有限的生命周期。摩尔定律（Moore's law）是计算能力进步中一个常被引用的趋势，它指出最先进微处理器的处理能力大约每两年翻一番。这意味着，最终处理器将达到足以直接猜测通信所用加密密钥（encryption keys）所需的计算强度。
Security professionals must keep this cryptographic life cycle in mind when selecting an encryption algorithm and have appropriate governance controls in place to ensure that the algorithms, protocols, and key lengths selected are sufficient to preserve the integrity of a cryptosystem for however long it is necessary to keep the information it is protecting secret. Security professionals can use the following algorithm and protocol governance controls: Specifying the cryptographic algorithms (such as AES and RSA) acceptable for use in an organization Identifying the acceptable key lengths for use with each algorithm based on the sensitivity of information transmitted Enumerating the secure transaction protocols (such as TLS) that may be used For example, if you're designing a cryptographic system to protect the security of business plans that you expect to execute next week, you don't need to worry about the theoretical risk that a processor capable of decrypting them might be developed a decade from now. On the other hand, if you're protecting the confidentiality of information that could be used to construct a nuclear bomb, it's virtually certain that you'll still want that information to remain secret 10 years in the future!
安全专业人员在选择加密算法时，必须牢记这一密码生命周期（cryptographic life cycle），并部署适当的治理控制（governance controls），以确保所选用的算法、协议和密钥长度足以在需要保护信息机密性的整个期间内维持密码系统的完整性。安全专业人员可采用以下算法与协议治理控制措施： - 规定组织内可接受的加密算法（如 AES 和 RSA） - 根据所传输信息的敏感度，确定每种算法可接受的密钥长度 - 列举允许使用的安全交易协议（如 TLS） 例如，如果你正在设计一个加密系统来保护预计下周执行的商业计划的安全性，则无需担心十年后可能出现能够解密这些计划的处理器这一理论风险。另一方面，如果你正在保护可用于制造核弹的信息的机密性，那么几乎可以肯定，你仍然希望这些信息在未来 10 年内保持机密！
## Summary
## 总结
Cryptographers and cryptanalysts are in a never-ending race to develop more secure cryptosystems and advanced cryptanalytic techniques designed to circumvent those systems.
密码学家与密码分析学家之间展开着一场永无止境的竞赛：一方致力于开发更安全的密码系统（Cryptosystems），另一方则不断设计先进的密码分析（Cryptanalytic）技术以突破这些系统。
Cryptography dates back as early as Caesar and has been an ongoing topic of study for many years. In this chapter, you learned some of the fundamental concepts underlying the field of cryptography and gained a basic understanding of the terminology used by cryptographers.
密码学（Cryptography）的历史可追溯至凯撒（Caesar）时代，多年来一直是持续研究的课题。在本章中，您学习了密码学领域的一些基本概念，并对密码学家所使用的术语有了初步了解。
This chapter also examined the similarities and differences between symmetric key cryptography (where communicating parties use the same key) and asymmetric key cryptography (where each communicator has a pair of public and private keys). You learned how hashing may be used to guarantee integrity and how hashes play a role in the digital signature process that guarantees nonrepudiation.
本章还探讨了对称密钥密码学（Symmetric Key Cryptography，通信双方使用相同密钥）与非对称密钥密码学（Asymmetric Key Cryptography，每个通信方拥有一对公私钥）之间的异同。您学习了如何利用哈希（Hashing）来保证完整性（Integrity），以及哈希在确保不可否认性（Nonrepudiation）的数字签名（Digital Signature）过程中所发挥的作用。
We then analyzed some of the symmetric algorithms currently available and their strengths and weaknesses. We wrapped up the chapter by taking a look at the cryptographic life cycle and the role of algorithm/protocol governance in enterprise security.
随后，我们分析了当前可用的部分对称算法（Symmetric Algorithms）及其优势与不足。本章最后，我们探讨了密码生命周期（Cryptographic Life Cycle）以及算法/协议治理（Algorithm/Protocol Governance）在企业安全中所扮演的角色。
The next chapter expands this discussion to cover contemporary public key cryptographic algorithms. Additionally, some of the common cryptanalytic techniques used to defeat both types of cryptosystems will be explored.
下一章将扩展本讨论，涵盖当代公钥密码算法（Public Key Cryptographic Algorithms）。此外，还将探讨一些用于攻破这两类密码系统的常见密码分析技术（Cryptanalytic Techniques）。

CHAPTER 4 Study Essentials

## Study Essentials
## 学习要点
### Understand the role that confidentiality, integrity, and
### 理解机密性、完整性和
### nonrepudiation play in cryptosystems. Confidentiality is one of
### 不可否认性在密码系统中的作用。机密性是
the major goals of cryptography. It protects the secrecy of data while it is both at rest and in transit. Integrity provides the recipient of a message with the assurance that data was not altered (intentionally or unintentionally) between the time it was created and the time it was accessed. Nonrepudiation provides undeniable proof that the sender of a message actually authored it. It prevents the sender from subsequently denying that they sent the original message.
密码学的主要目标之一是保护数据在静态存储和传输过程中的机密性。完整性为消息接收方提供保证，确保数据在创建到访问期间未被（有意或无意）篡改。不可否认性提供无可辩驳的证据，证明消息的发送者确实是该消息的作者。它防止发送者事后否认曾发送过原始消息。
### Know how cryptosystems can be used to achieve
### 了解密码系统如何用于实现
### authentication goals. Authentication provides assurances as to
### 认证目标。 认证提供关于
the identity of a user. One possible scheme that uses authentication is the challenge-response protocol, in which the remote user is asked to encrypt a message using a key known only to the communicating parties. Authentication can be achieved with both symmetric and asymmetric cryptosystems.
用户身份。一种采用认证的典型方案是挑战-响应协议（Challenge-Response Protocol），该协议要求远程用户使用仅通信双方知晓的密钥对消息进行加密。认证可通过对称密码系统（Symmetric Cryptosystem）与非对称密码系统（Asymmetric Cryptosystem）共同实现。
### Be familiar with the basic terminology of cryptography. When
### 熟悉密码学的基本术语。 当
a sender wants to transmit a private message to a recipient, the sender takes the plaintext (unencrypted) message and encrypts it using an algorithm and a key. This produces a ciphertext message that is transmitted to the recipient. The recipient then uses a similar algorithm and key to decrypt the ciphertext and re-create the original plaintext message for viewing.
当发送方希望向接收方传输一条私密消息时，发送方将明文（未加密）消息通过算法和密钥进行加密，生成密文消息并传输给接收方。接收方随后使用相似的算法和密钥对密文进行解密，重新生成原始明文消息以供查看。
### Understand the difference between a code and a cipher and
### 理解代码（Code）与密码（Cipher）之间的区别以及
### explain the basic types of ciphers. Codes are cryptographic
### 解释密码（Cipher）的基本类型。 代码（Code）是密码学（Cryptographic）的
systems of symbols that operate on words or phrases and are sometimes secret but don't always provide confidentiality. Ciphers, however, are always meant to hide the true meaning of a message. Know how the following types of ciphers work: transposition ciphers, substitution ciphers (including one-time pads), stream ciphers, and block ciphers.
符号系统（Code）作用于单词或短语，有时是保密的，但并非总能提供机密性（Confidentiality）。而密码（Cipher）则始终旨在隐藏消息的真实含义。请掌握以下类型密码的工作原理：置换密码（Transposition Cipher）、替代密码（Substitution Cipher，包括一次性密码本 One-Time Pad）、流密码（Stream Cipher）以及分组密码（Block Cipher）。
Know the requirements for successful use of a one-time pad. For a one-time pad to be successful, the key must be generated randomly without any known pattern. The key must be at least as long as the message to be encrypted. The pads must be protected against physical disclosure, and each pad must be used only one time and then discarded.
掌握成功使用一次性密码本（One-Time Pad）的要求。要使一次性密码本成功，密钥必须随机生成，且不得存在任何已知模式。密钥的长度必须至少与待加密的消息长度相等。密码本必须受到保护，防止物理泄露（Physical Disclosure），且每个密码本仅能使用一次，使用后必须丢弃。
### Understand split knowledge. Split knowledge means that the
### 理解分割知识（Split Knowledge）。分割知识意味着该...
information or privilege required to perform an operation is divided among multiple users. This ensures that no single person has sufficient privileges to compromise the security of the environment. M of N Control is an example of split knowledge used in key recovery and other sensitive tasks.
执行某项操作所需的信息或权限被分割给多个用户。这确保了没有任何单个用户拥有足以破坏环境安全的权限。N中取M控制（M of N Control）是分割知识在密钥恢复及其他敏感任务中的一个应用实例。
### Understand work function (work factor). Work function, or work
### 理解工作函数（工作因子）。 工作函数，或工作
factor, is a way to measure the strength of a cryptography system by measuring the effort in terms of cost and/or time to decrypt messages. Usually, the time and effort required to perform a complete brute-force attack against an encryption system is what a work function rating represents. The security and protection offered by a cryptosystem is directly proportional to the value of its work function/factor.
工作因子是一种衡量密码系统强度的方法，通过测量解密消息所需付出的成本与/或时间来评估。通常，工作函数评级所代表的是对加密系统执行完整暴力破解攻击所需的时间与精力。密码系统所提供的安全性与保护程度，与其工作函数/工作因子（work function/factor）的值成正比。
### Understand the importance of key security. Cryptographic keys
### 理解密钥安全的重要性。 密码密钥
provide the necessary element of secrecy to a cryptosystem. Modern cryptosystems utilize keys that are at least 128 bits long to provide adequate security.
密钥为密码系统提供必要的保密性要素。现代密码系统使用至少128位长的密钥来提供足够的安全性。
### Know the differences between symmetric and asymmetric
### 了解对称加密与非对称加密之间的区别
### cryptosystems. Symmetric key cryptosystems (or secret key
### 密码系统。对称密钥密码系统（或秘密密钥）
cryptosystems) rely on the use of a shared secret key. They are much faster than asymmetric algorithms, but they lack support for the following: scalability, easy key distribution, and nonrepudiation. Asymmetric cryptosystems use public-private key pairs for communication between parties but operate much more slowly than symmetric algorithms.
密码系统）依赖于使用共享秘密密钥。它们比非对称算法快得多，但缺乏对以下特性的支持：可扩展性、易于密钥分发以及不可否认性（Nonrepudiation）。非对称密码系统使用公私钥对进行通信方之间的交互，但其运行速度远慢于对称算法。
### Be able to explain the basic operational modes of symmetric
### 能够解释对称密码的基本工作模式
### cryptosystems. Symmetric cryptosystems operate in several
### 密码系统。 对称密码系统运行在几种
discrete modes, including Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode, Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode, Cipher Feedback (CFB) mode, Output Feedback (OFB) mode, Counter (CTR) mode, Galois/Counter mode (GCM), and Counter with Cipher Block Chaining Message Authentication Code mode (CCM). ECB mode is considered the least secure and is used only for short messages. 3DES uses three iterations of DES with two or three different keys to increase the effective key strength to 112 or 168 bits, respectively.
离散模式，包括电子密码本（ECB）模式、密码分组链接（CBC）模式、密码反馈（CFB）模式、输出反馈（OFB）模式、计数器（CTR）模式、伽罗瓦/计数器模式（GCM）以及带密码分组链接消息认证码的计数器模式（CCM）。ECB模式被认为安全性最低，仅用于短消息。3DES使用两个或三个不同的密钥对DES进行三次迭代，分别将有效密钥强度提升至112位或168位。
### Know the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). The Advanced
### 了解高级加密标准（AES）。高级
Encryption Standard (AES) uses the Rijndael algorithm and is the U.S. government standard for the secure exchange of sensitive but unclassified data. AES uses key lengths of 128, 192, and 256 bits and a fixed block size of 128 bits to achieve a much higher level of security than that provided by the older DES algorithm.
加密标准（AES）采用Rijndael算法，是美国政府用于安全交换敏感但非机密数据的标准。AES使用128位、192位和256位的密钥长度，以及固定的128位块大小，从而实现了比旧版DES算法高得多的安全级别。

## Written Lab
## 书面实验

3. Decrypt the message “F R Q J U D W X O D W L R Q V B R X J R W L W” using the Caesar ROT3 substitution cipher.
1. 确保数据机密性时，阻碍一次性密码本（One-Time Pad）密码系统广泛采用的主要障碍是什么？ 2. 使用关键字 SECURE 通过列换位（Columnar Transposition）加密消息“I will pass the CISSP exam and become certified next month”。 3. 使用凯撒 ROT3 替换密码（Caesar ROT3 Substitution Cipher）解密消息“F R Q J U D W X O D W L R Q V B R X J R W L W”。
